messages:
Alex: Heads-up team - aiming to publish the product post Thu 10:00 PT. Need owners for: final hero line, benchmark stat wording + short methodology note, production UI screenshot from eng, top-of-post webinar signup with prefill, HubSpot hidden-field wiring + UTMs, and legal quick pass. Call out who can take which? :calendar:

Noor: I9ll draft the hero and the bench phrasing. Will avoid superlatives and include a 1-line methodology note. Two hero directions incoming.

Ben: I can grab the screenshot from staging and annotate for the post. Ping me the exact page and desired viewport. Also will export 1200x630 and a retina variant.

Priya: I9ll set up the HubSpot form + hidden fields. Plan: add hidden fields `lead_source=blog_post`, `product_interest=inference`, `orig_utm`. Will also wire the `email` prefill param so querystring `?email=` preloads.

AssetBot: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood/assets/announce_ui_2026_v1.png and a cropped hero candidate announce_hero_flat.png. Suggest hero crop 1200x600 for blog template.

Jaime (Legal): Quick note on the benchmark claim language: swap any absolute phrasing. Example edit: change "cuts inference costs 60%" -> "internal tests show up to 60% reduction in per-token inference cost" and add a short parenthetical about test setup. Also avoid term "enterprise-grade" unless we list exact SLAs; use "enterprise-ready" or "built for production."

Noor: Thanks Jaime. I'll add: "Internal benchmarks on representative LLM workloads show up to 60% reduction in per-token inference cost (see methodology)." Methodology blurb: "10k request sample across mixed-length prompts, 8xA100 baseline, end-to-end measurements."2-line max.

Alex: Prefer the wording that emphasizes "built for production" rather than SLA promises. Noor - push both hero variants to the doc and we'll pick.

Ben: Screenshot request: please confirm page is `console.redwood.com/demo?model=test`. I9ll capture token stats panel and response stream example. Any sensitive data?

Priya: Ok Ben - safe to use sample account `marketing-demo@redwood` and scrub any real org names. Also I9ll ensure the registration link includes `?email={{email}}&utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=announce_q2&utm_content={cta_variant}` for A/B.

Noor: Hero options uploaded to /content/drafts/announce-hero-options.md:
1) "Fast, reliable LLM serving built for production."
2) "High-throughput inference with predictable economics."
Which should be primary?

Alex: Use option 1 on the page and option 2 for paid promos. Ben - can you make sure the CTA text matches hero length?

Ben: Yep. Suggest CTA: "See it in action" (short) and alternative "Get started with Redwood Inference" for paid. Will adjust screenshot crop to match.

Priya: For lead routing: hidden field `company_size` on form. Rule: company_size >= 500 -> route to Enterprise AE queue. Also mark any form value `product_interest=dedicated` as high-priority. Will document SFDC mappings and add tags.

Jaime (Legal): Reviewing the updated draft after Noor's changes. One more nit: replace "industry-leading" with "industry-proven" or remove qualifier entirely.

Noor: Done - removed "industry-leading". Added the bench caveat and the 2-line methodology. Pushed update to /content/drafts/announce_blog.md.

Alex: Checklist for publish - reply with :white_check_mark: when done: hero locked, bench caveat included, screenshot uploaded, assets optimized, HubSpot form + hidden fields done, UTMs/A/B set, legal sign-off.

Noor: Hero + bench caveat - done. :white_check_mark:

Ben: Screenshot uploaded and cropped, png + retina exported. :white_check_mark:

AssetBot: Optimized hero export 1200x600 and generated webp. :white_check_mark:

Priya: HubSpot form created, hidden fields added, email prefill verified, UTMs wired for cta_a/cta_b, and SFDC routing doc updated. :white_check_mark:

Jaime (Legal): Final sign-off - approved with the bench language and no SLA phrasing. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Great work. Scheduling for Thu 10:00 PT. I'll post the publish checklist in the release channel once scheduled. :tada:
